notes: Go's complex128 is rust_stdlib::strconv::Complex (with Add/Sub/Mul/Neg and Go's Div, which is the runtime's complex128div). Algorithms, special values and branch cuts are Go's; only the real functions they call are this crate's math ports.

Cos.note: Built on math.Exp, Sinh or Cosh; the last bits of finite results differ from Go's because Go's Exp is platform assembly (relative error below 1e-12 over the differential). Special values and branch cuts match. Go's own last bits differ between amd64 (with and without FMA) and arm64 assembly; results are within Go's documented accuracy and special values match exactly. Implementation-defined, like unstable sort order.
